headline: Lynn take a seven-match unbeaten run to Flagler
dek: Lynn's win over AUM was their fifth in a row, and two of the five came against Barry and Florida Southern, both of whom had beaten them earlier in the season. They sit fifth on the conference table, eight points behind Florida Tech, who have not played since losing at Rollins.
displaced_by: Lynn beat AUM for a fifth straight win, so the run the standing headline placed at Florida Southern has moved on and the dek's 'last six' undercounts it; the new lines are about the unbeaten stretch Lynn take to Flagler, not the win that extended it.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Florida Southern have outscored every other programme, but goals have not settled the table: Florida Tech lead it on a total from the middle of the pack.

wire.line: Florida Tech finish the conference season top of the table, Embry-Riddle second.
